title: Label smoothing hurts perplexity
description: Label smoothing makes the model less confident, which decreases perplexity but ultimately improves BLEU score. The authors acknowledge this negative side effect on perplexity as a trade-off.
canonical_description: label smoothing reduces perplexity as a side effect while improving accuracy and BLEU score

evidence.quote: This hurts perplexity, as the model learns to be more unsure, but improves accuracy and BLEU score.
